gloss: to listen intently; to be absorbed in listening

definitions.gloss: to listen intently; to be lost in listening
definitions.explanation: To listen with full attention, so absorbed in a sound, voice or story that one forgets everything else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}る。
examples.english: To be absorbed in the music.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children were listening intently to the teacher's story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{歌声|うたごえ}→歌声：20116_utagoe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}った。
examples.english: Everyone in the hall listened in silence, absorbed in her beautiful singing.

notes:
⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) + {入|い}る (to go in deeply). The thing listened to takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}る: to be absorbed in music
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{聞|き}き{入|い}る: to listen intently to a story or talk
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{聞|き}き{入|い}る: to find oneself listening intently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聞|き}き{惚|ほ}れる: to listen enraptured; stresses admiration for a beautiful sound
- ⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧: to lend an ear; deliberate attention rather than absorption
